watermark-pdf.formula:
tiled_cols = ceil(pageW / (textW + 140))
tiled_rows = ceil(pageH / (size × 3.2))

Example: A4 page 595.28 × 841.89 pt, “DRAFT” in 72 pt bold ≈ 243 pt wide.
cols = ceil(595.28 / 383) = 2; rows = ceil(841.89 / 230.4) = 4.
Result: 8 diagonal watermarks tiled across each page.

limitations: A watermark is a visual mark, not copy protection — determined users can still photograph the page.
Very small text watermarks may look soft when printed large.
Image watermarks are scaled proportionally; extremely wide logos may shrink to fit.
Password-protected PDFs that need a password prompt cannot be watermarked.

watermark-pdf.workedExample:
A 3-page A4 proposal, text “DRAFT”, 72 pt bold, gray, 18% opacity, diagonal 45°.
Text width ≈ 243 pt.
Tiled grid: cols = ceil(595.28 / (243 + 140)) = ceil(1.55) = 2.
rows = ceil(841.89 / (72 × 3.2)) = ceil(3.65) = 4.
Each of the 3 pages gets 8 translucent DRAFT marks — 24 marks total in the downloaded PDF.
